policy: Every level introduces one memorable lesson character. Later levels may bring that character back through a natural story encounter or an optional hint earned after a genuine attempt. A callback may recall an investigative habit but must never state or expose the new answer.
callback_guardrails: A returning character asks or demonstrates; they do not solve the new task.
Narrative callbacks must make sense even when the player does not remember the earlier level.
Hint callbacks unlock only after an attempt or through an optional book code.
No required lesson, answer or route is locked behind remembering a character.

characters.name: Tavi
characters.lesson_memory: Name what is here before naming what is missing.
characters.return_rule: Bring Tavi back naturally when a later claim needs careful looking. Tavi may ask what the player can check first, but cannot identify the new answer.

planned_level_slots.callback: Tavi arrives carrying the old empty box as an ordinary story prop and asks where the player would look first; the E02 answer remains undisclosed.
An earlier character can appear after the first attempt with a process hint, never the result.
